name: Vultr Cloud Compute

evidence.vps: 03: rented virtual machine; Vultr operates the cloud and the customer maintains the OS and app

line: Run websites, APIs and databases on a virtual server you manage.

free.text: Free VM: 1 vCPU/512 MB/10 GB, 0 GB plan bandwidth; access terms unclear

work.math: $3.50 plan + $0.70 default backups = $4.20 a month subtotal before tax. 100 GB fits the 512 GB allowance, but the plan's single location is not named, so availability at EWR is not verified.
$5 plan (1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 1 TB transfer) + $1 default backups = $6 a month. São Paulo costs $7.50 plus backups. Backups can be turned off for $5. No separate IPv4 price is stated.

$20 plan + $4 default backups = $24 a month subtotal before tax. 100 GB fits 3 TB. Daily database dumps need setup. Snapshots cost $0.05 per GB a month (size unknown), and availability at EWR is not verified.
